title: Expect The Unexpected
summary:
Change is the only constant in the Mediterranean Sea
The Mediterranean, or the "Med" as it is known in shipping circles, is one of the most important bodies of water in maritime history. The Mediterranean played a central role in the history of Western civilization. The empires of the Greeks, Egyptians, Romans and the Ottomans were all concentrated around the Mediterranean.
